# DeliverX

> DeliverX turns realistic product management work into traceable evidence, explainable capability judgements, and career-ready proof.

DeliverX keeps self-report, coach confirmation, AI-assisted scoring, and external verification distinct. Only an outside attestation activates Verified.

## Products

- [How DeliverX works](/how-it-works): The evidence, judgement, readiness, and verification method.
- [Experience](/experience): Realistic simulated product work that produces inspectable artefacts.
- [Launchpad](/launchpad): Evidence-backed portfolios, interview preparation, and application tracking.
- [Professional Workspace](/professional-workspace): Human-led product delivery with consent-controlled AI assistance.
- [Plans](/pricing): Current monthly products and prices.

## Guides

- [Resources](/resources): DeliverX guides and product orientation.
- [Build an evaluable PM portfolio](/resources/pm-portfolio): How to connect claims to work an employer can inspect.
- [Ground STAR stories in evidence](/resources/star-interview-stories): How to prepare interview stories from real artefacts.
